info.title: Zephium backend HTTP contract
info.description: Repository contract only; no public deployment, provider availability, or approved prices asserted. Signed opaque bearer sessions use email-code sign-in; hosted models are disabled by default.

post.summary: Request a sign-in code for an existing or eligible new account

202.description: Generic acceptance. Eligible sends await bounded provider acceptance; suppressed addresses remain indistinguishable.

200.description: Account export without credentials, including the current processed avatar

get.summary: Inspect reconciled billing state and Polar-priced offers

post.description: Requires enabled billing and an offered product. The checkout is bound to the caller, product, and policy revision.
Returns 409 no_billing_account when the caller has no Polar customer; other provider failures return 503.
Consumes a purpose-bound email code, seals the account, and revokes sessions.

get.summary: List plan-filtered catalog, including locked models and role defaults
get.description: Only enabled provider-backed models appear; available=false means the caller cannot use that model. Disabled policy returns empty models and null defaults.
Integer accounting units; credit_units is 10000. Legacy unit_scale remains 1000000.

put.summary: Set or clear daily credit limit

oneOf.description: Integer accounting units as a decimal string; credit_units is 10000 units per displayed credit

get.description: Only state=settled establishes a final charged amount; generated content is never returned.

200.description: Provider-native JSON or SSE. X-Zephium-Request-Id and X-Zephium-Policy-Revision returned; JSON also has X-Zephium-Usage.

X-Zephium-Usage.description: JSON only; streams use a best-effort accounting comment

post.description: Provider-native accepted top-level fields only; policy and protocol validation may reject unsupported modes. Hosted cloud service required. Admission reserves a conservative local credit hold without a provider token-count preflight. Final charge uses reported actual usage. SSE preserves native provider frames and may append a best-effort Zephium accounting comment after the provider terminal event; consume through EOF and consult the request receipt if absent.

post.summary: Transcribe a bounded PCM16 mono WAV recording
post.description: At most min(model max_request_bytes,8 MiB) multipart, WAV at most16kHz and240 seconds,85-second overall deadline including upload. No request replay or stored audio/transcript. Customer billing uses authoritative audio/text tokens, or an explicit duration tariff only for a successful response with absent usage.

200.description: JSON text only, at most64KiB. Silence may produce empty text.

put.summary: Replace the caller avatar with a normalized private image
put.description: One file part only, at most 2097152 bytes plus 16384 bytes of multipart framing. Single-frame input only; decoded dimensions and processing time are bounded. Six attempts per hour per account.

file.description: Still PNG, JPEG or WebP; maximum 2 MiB

get.summary: Read the caller current private avatar
get.description: Authentication and current-version ownership are checked before conditional responses. Foreign, deleted and superseded versions return avatar_not_found. Cache-Control: private, no-cache; Vary: Authorization.

200.description: Normalized 256x256 WebP with exact Content-Length, strong ETag and nosniff

304.description: Authenticated current representation is unchanged; no response body

post.summary: Join the Linux release notification list without email confirmation
post.description: Public, cookie-free route; requires exact WAITLIST_WEB_ORIGIN Origin and WAITLIST_ENABLED=true. Do not send authentication. JSON body limit 2048 bytes. See docs/linux-waitlist-integration.md. Records a single opt-in immediately; sends no email and does not verify mailbox ownership. The optional website field is a honeypot and must be empty. Generic 202 for duplicates and suppressed requests.
